title: Lesson 141 · Sally's first train ride
titleZh: 第141课 萨莉第一次乘火车旅行

examples.en: My four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.
examples.zh: 我四岁的女儿萨莉被邀请参加一个儿童聚会。

examples.en: My daughter was invited to a children's party.
examples.zh: 我女儿被邀请参加一个儿童聚会。

examples.en: I decided to take her by train.
Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.
examples.zh: 萨莉非常激动，因为她从未坐过火车。

examples.en: A middle-aged lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
examples.zh: 一位中年女士上了火车，坐在萨莉对面。
那位女士坐在萨莉对面。

examples.en: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
examples.zh: 萨莉没有回答，只是好奇地看着她。

examples.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
examples.zh: 那位女士穿着一件蓝色外套，戴着一顶又大又滑稽的帽子。

examples.en: The lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
examples.zh: 那位女士打开手提包，拿出粉盒。

examples.en: She took out her powder compact.
'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.
examples.zh: '为了让自己漂亮，'那位女士答道。

examples.en: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.
Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
examples.zh: 萨莉感到很好笑，我却非常尴尬！

article.en: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.
article.zh: 上周，我四岁的女儿萨莉被邀请参加一个儿童聚会。

article.en: I decided to take her by train.
Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.
article.zh: 萨莉非常激动，因为她从未坐过火车。

article.en: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw.
article.zh: 她坐在车窗旁，对看到的一切都问个不停。

article.en: Suddenly, a middle-aged lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
article.zh: 突然，一位中年女士上了火车，坐在萨莉对面。

article.en: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
article.zh: 萨莉没有回答，只是好奇地看着她。

article.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
article.zh: 那位女士穿着一件蓝色外套，戴着一顶又大又滑稽的帽子。

article.en: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
article.zh: 火车驶出车站后，那位女士打开手提包，拿出粉盒。

article.en: She then began to make up her face.
article.zh: 然后她开始往脸上扑粉。

article.en: 'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.
article.zh: '为了让自己漂亮，'那位女士答道。

article.en: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.
